hash_verification: Downloaded bytes match size and LFS SHA-256 from the official author's pinned HF revision linked by the official GitHub README.
declared_counting_training: FSC147 training split plus 1000 synthetic mosaic images, on a GroundingDINO foundation.
target_protocol: No local CARPK/TRANCOS-finetuned weights are used. Official paper reports no fine-tuning on other evaluation datasets. Foundation pretraining image overlap is not independently audited.
source_validation_caveat: Official FSC147 pretraining predates local duplicate/quarantine filtering. The local filter cannot undo checkpoint exposure; FSC147 smoke validation is a diagnostic, not a newly independent holdout.
runtime_patch: Enable the existing PyTorch deformable-attention fallback on CUDA when the custom extension is unavailable. Patch and code hashes are recorded in each run.
